# Adgent

> The AI media buyer for performance marketers. Adgent connects to your ad platforms,
> reasons about your account, and delivers one brief each morning — the verdict first,
> the evidence underneath. It proposes actions and executes them on your approval.

Adgent. It reads Meta and Google Ads through the
platforms' own APIs, enriches with GA4 and Merchant Center, and reconciles platform
claims against ground-truth revenue. It is read-only by default; every write action to
a live ad account is approval-gated.

What separates Adgent from a dashboard: a dashboard renders your data and hands the
analysis back to you. Adgent commits to a conclusion, ranks by impact, says how
confident it is and why, and leaves out anything that didn't change the answer.

## Product

- [Adgent — The AI media buyer that acts on your word](https://adgent.app/): Adgent is the AI analyst for performance marketers. One brief each morning across Meta and Google — the verdict first, evidence underneath.
- [Adgent features — what an AI media buyer actually does](https://adgent.app/features): The daily verdict, ground truth against real margin, a Trust Gate that refuses unreachable targets, creative read scene by scene, and a full change ledger.
- [Why Adgent — analyze or act, everything else makes you choose](https://adgent.app/why-adgent): Reporting tools go deep but never touch the account. Platform AIs act, but never on your side. See the capability matrix, category by category.
- [Pricing — plans that scale with ad spend — Adgent](https://adgent.app/pricing): Adgent covers Meta and Google Ads on every plan, and reads GA4 and Search Console for context. Talk to sales for pricing.

## Capabilities

- [The daily verdict on every ad account — Adgent](https://adgent.app/daily-verdict): Adgent reads every connected Meta and Google account overnight and writes the verdict in plain language, ranked by cost. The account needing you is on top.
- [Ground truth — judged on your margin — Adgent](https://adgent.app/ground-truth): An ad platform optimises toward its own pixel. It never sees your cost of goods or second-order value. Adgent reconciles against GA4 and Search Console.
- [The Trust Gate — a tool that can say no — Adgent](https://adgent.app/trust-gate): Adgent refuses unreachable targets and flags metrics that can't be trusted yet, using the account's own numbers as the reason — before any budget moves.
- [Creative intelligence, scene by scene — Adgent](https://adgent.app/creative-intelligence): Adgent reads live creative the way a senior buyer would: its DNA, the story beat by beat, and exactly where viewers leave. No upload step.
- [The Change Ledger — every change, undoable — Adgent](https://adgent.app/change-ledger): Every change is captured with the exact value it replaced, so undoing it is a restore rather than a reconstruction — which is what makes approving one cheap. Platform-side changes are dated too.
- [Account memory — you explain the account once](https://adgent.app/account-memory): Your rules, exceptions and the calls you already made are carried into every verdict after. Nothing to configure, nothing to repeat next month.
- [What it builds — campaigns, plans, dashboards — Adgent](https://adgent.app/built-from-chat): A campaign, a media plan, a live dashboard or a standing report — described in one sentence and built on your own data. The two that can change an account arrive drafted and paused, waiting for your approval.

## By industry

- [Paid ads for ecommerce — Adgent](https://adgent.app/ecommerce): 19.3% of online sales come back, landing after the quarter closes and rewriting reported numbers — and ad spend is subtracted last, beneath four deductions.
- [Paid ads for lead generation — Adgent](https://adgent.app/lead-generation): Google keeps a GCLID for 90 days; B2B SaaS CAC payback runs 16 months. The identifier dies before the revenue exists, and no dashboard alarms on it.
- [Paid ads for hotels and travel — Adgent](https://adgent.app/travel-hospitality): The conversion fires at booking; revenue exists at stay. OTA bookings cancel at 21.8% vs 10.6% direct, roughly 79 days after the click — outside every window.
- [Paid ads for marketplaces — Adgent](https://adgent.app/marketplaces): At a 13% take rate, a campaign reporting 6x ROAS runs at 0.8x on real revenue. Marketplaces have two costs of acquisition; the platform sees only one.
- [Paid ads for multi-location brands — Adgent](https://adgent.app/local-multi-location): Google store visits are modelled and panel-calibrated, not measured. Only 61% of callers reach a person. And near full capacity, more budget buys no-shows.
- [Paid ads for mobile apps and games — Adgent](https://adgent.app/mobile-apps): SKAN returns a 0-63 number on delayed windows with deliberate jitter, and nulls below undisclosed thresholds. Creative lifespan has fallen to 5-14 days.

- [Adgent for agencies — a senior buyer on each client account](https://adgent.app/for-agencies): Adgent puts senior judgment on every client account: read overnight across Meta and Google, one account at a time, applied only when your team approves.
- [Adgent for in-house teams — the senior you don't have](https://adgent.app/for-in-house): Running paid alone? Adgent reads Meta and Google overnight, checks platform numbers against what your store actually banked, and prepares the fix for approval.

- [Google Ads CPA rise: Aug 2026 bidding change — Adgent](https://adgent.app/google-ads-target-cpa-roas-change-2026): On Aug 17, 2026 Google makes budget-limited campaigns spend up to your Target CPA/ROAS. If you've been beating your target, your actual CPA will rise. Act first.
- [Google Ads account structure in 2026 — Adgent](https://adgent.app/google-ads-account-structure-2026): In 2026, Google Ads structure is about signal quality, not manual control: STAGs of 3-10 keywords, a Brand/Non-brand split, and 30+ conversions per campaign.
- [How much ad budget is wasted? — Adgent](https://adgent.app/how-much-ad-spend-is-wasted): WordStream's study of 15,666 accounts puts median wasted spend near a third of budget. A ranked playbook for finding each leak and pricing it.

- [Is Performance Max cannibalizing your branded search? — Adgent](https://adgent.app/performance-max-brand-cannibalization): Performance Max often takes credit for branded demand you'd win for free — inflating its ROAS while adding nothing. Here's how to spot it and stop it.
